items.name: ingame-under-the-canopy
items.prompt: Slow and spacious, warm and a little mysterious: a wooden flute carries a gentle, singing melody over warm sustained strings and slow harp arpeggios, a French horn answers softly, a low wordless choir swells once, distant soft frame drums mark the pulse. D minor, slow tempo. A 30-second instrumental piece of background music for a fantasy real-time strategy game, played under the gameplay: a real composed piece with a clear melody and harmony, calmer and more spacious than a main theme, made to loop. Live orchestral and acoustic instruments only. No nature sounds, no birds or insects, no ambient soundscape, no drum kit, no synths, no electronic sound, no sung words.
items.title: Under the canopy
